SAMPLE LETTER. This is a saved example, not a letter written for you. On the live site the generator writes a new one from the company, job title and job description you give it.

Dear Hiring Team at Example Company,

I am writing about the Salesforce Architect role. I design, build and document Salesforce systems end to end, and this site is one of them. Every case study, skill and timeline entry you have read here is a record in my own Salesforce org, served through an allowlisted API and built into these pages.

As a Salesforce application architect I planned and built the custom data model behind a program management application, covering participants, programs, funding and outcomes, and I have run that application from planning through implementation. Alongside that I integrated Salesforce with Power Automate and ran the Talend integration engines, including the upgrade to Talend 8.0. On a new CRM development team I set up the DevOps pipeline and the code review standards, and built the training plan for two new developers.

I write each decision down as I make it, in architecture decision records you can read on the Docs page. I test the parts most likely to break, and my pipeline fails loudly when something is wrong instead of reporting success. That is the habit I would bring to your team.

I would welcome a conversation about where that could help Example Company.

Kind regards,
Ryan Bumstead
